_comment: Re-captures the ten AgentCPU traces from the recorded sessions (agentcpu and agentcpu_rust images; build them with ./sci --build-image after workloads/agentcpu/fetch_bench.sh). Each configuration replays one bundle under DynamoRIO; SCARAB_MAIN_SHARD_GLOB in env_vars selects the traced process. Traces are not needed to simulate: the SimPoints are registered in workloads_db.json and ./sci --fetch-traces fetches the released files. To capture into an existing suite entry, rename the workload or remove its 'trace' key first (validate_tracing refuses registered workloads).

trace_configurations.env_vars: SCARAB_MAIN_SHARD_GLOB=drmemtrace.python3.10.* AGENT_MOCK_REPLAY_KEY=langchain_n2_287e338_1 AGENT_MOCK_REPLAY_ROOT=/tmp_home/agentcpu-bench/bundles/api PYTHONHASHSEED=0 AGENT_DETERMINISTIC_TRANSPORT=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 LITELLM_LOCAL_MODEL_COST_MAP=True GLIBC_TUNABLES=glibc.cpu.hwcaps=-AVX512F,-AVX512BW,-AVX512DQ,-AVX512VL OPENBLAS_CORETYPE=HASWELL
trace_configurations.binary_cmd: python3 -m agentcpu langchain --agentic-mode --tool-backend appworld --appworld-task 287e338_1 --task-id trace --seed 42 --context-size short --iterations 2 --trace-output /tmp/agent_trace.json --summary-output /tmp/agent_summary.json
